Ana: Quick question — as we roll out the new scoped-role routing we don't have a clean telemetry contract for: sampling buckets, why a request hit fallback routing, and which role was evaluated (hint: preview vs granted). Do we want an API field or telemetry-only solution? :eyes:
Matt: We need both. Telemetry for analytics/debug, API for live UI hints (console preview). Minimal change: attach an opt-in metadata blob to authz responses so the console can show "why" without extra calls. Telemetry events can copy that blob.
Jess: I worry about response size and perf. Any extra fields must be optional and gated behind a flag (customer opt-in for enterprise).
Liu: Also PII concern — can't log principal emails in telemetry. Keep IDs and role names only. GDPR customers should opt-in to the metadata.
Ana: Agreed. Proposal: add an optional header `X-RW-Perm-Meta` (base64 JSON) in authz responses when `perm_meta=true` query/header is present. Console will request it for previews/canaries only. Telemetry event `perm.rollout.decision` will include the same minimal fields (no emails).
Matt: Example payload we discussed (minimal):
```json
{
  "role_applied": "route-beta-reader",
  "source": "scope-rollout",
  "sample_group": "canary-2026-03-12",
  "reason": "match_scope_affinity",
  "rbac_schema": "v2"
}
```
Jess: That looks OK. Two asks: 1) ensure we can turn off in Dedicated/Private by default, 2) make sure size < 2KB so we don't break proxies.
Liu: For telemetry events we'll emit: `perm.rollout.decision` with props: `route`, `sample_group`, `decision` (allow/deny/fallback), `rbac_schema`, `role_applied`. No user identifiers except service principal id when relevant.
Ana: UX question — in the console preview we want a small "why this role" line and a link to the rollout config. Console team can display the `reason` and `sample_group`. Is that enough?
Jess: Yes, but add a boolean `preview=true` when the preview route was used (so we can differentiate preview evaluations from actual traffic).
Matt: Implementation notes: update `authz` internal API v2 to accept `perm_meta` param and optionally return header. Backward compatible: default false. Small change in route proxy to allow `X-RW-Perm-Meta`.
Liu: Telemetry snippet (example event):
```json
{
  "event": "perm.rollout.decision",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sample_group": "canary-2026-03-12",
  "decision": "fallback",
  "role_applied": "reader",
  "rbac_schema": "v2",
  "preview": true
}
```
Matt: Anyone care about tying this into the existing trace/span? We can add span tags `rbac.sample_group` and `rbac.reason`. That would make debugging easier.
Jess: Yes, prefer span tags + telemetry event. Less duplication in dashboards.
Ana: Ok action items: 1) Matt to open a small API PR to add `perm_meta` flag + header change (draft the header contract), 2) Liu to add the telemetry event spec + dashboard skeleton (perm.rollout.* metrics aggregated by sample_group/decision), 3) Jess to add privacy gating and size limit to Dedicated/Private config, 4) Console to prototype the "why" microcopy with `reason` + `sample_group`.
Matt: I'll also add a short migration note: older clients ignore header; add server-side guard to only attach when downstream accepts big headers (nginx limit check).
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-15 03:00 UTC — service: authz-v2 — canary: 10% — owner: @Matt :shipit:
Ana: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow if there are any blockers. :thumbsup:
